context:
Goal: rules for building and trusting guards still reach every session that builds a guard.
Problem (rule): your 11:59 CST picks moved the two guard rules into a claude-settings file that install never copies, so a session building a check in another repo loses them, and only you can undo your pick.
Based on (ruling): your Nov 12 11:59 CST picks to move two rules out of the global file: trust a guard only once it fails on the mistake it guards against, and build a new guard only against a real mistake it would have stopped.
Based on (read): install.sh on main, read 13:14 CST: it links hooks, lint, skills, agents, settings.json and a CLAUDE.md pointer into ~/.claude, which every repo's session uses; it never installs .claude/rules, whose file loads only when a claude-settings session edits hooks/. How many other repos build their own checks is unmeasured.
Departs from: main keeps both rules in the global CLAUDE.md — b moves them to repo-only rule files, c to a new skill.

lastAnswer.note: dont those hooks go to any and all repos that call claude-settings? have we reviewed what the claude-settings install actually does to a repo as i feel liike this is a mistype

options.how: Both rules stay in the global CLAUDE.md; the other moves you accepted stand.
options.label: Keep both global (Recommended)
options.lose: About 60 words stay in the global file.

options.gain: About 60 words leave the global file.
options.how: Both rules move to the claude-settings rule files as you picked.
options.label: Move them anyway
options.lose: Other repos lose both rules, and guards outside hooks/ and lint/ load neither.

options.gain: The rules load where they are needed, in every repo.
options.how: Build a new skill that loads when a guard is built, in any repo, and home both rules there.
options.label: A guard-building skill
options.lose: A new skill to build, and it loads only when its description matches the task.

reply: Checked install.sh on main (13:14 CST). You're right that the guard hooks reach every repo: install links hooks, lint, skills, agents and settings into ~/.claude, so they run in every session. But it doesn't install the rule file the two rules moved to, which loads only in a claude-settings session that edits hooks/. So shared guards built here keep the rules, but a session building a check inside another repo (a q_max CI check, say) loses them, and so would guard work here under merge/, bin/, actions/ or .github/. The lane's point holds for those cases only. Pick again with that in mind: a keeps them global; b keeps your 11:59 move.
title: The two guard rules you moved at 11:59 stay global after all
why: It reverses part of your 11:59 pick, so it needs your word. Meanwhile the lane keeps both rules global in its PR.
